overview:
Josh Gottheimer seeks another term in a northern New Jersey district that leans only modestly Democratic. He enters the general election with an enormous financial edge: more than $13 million on hand against roughly $9,000 for Republican Sean Kirrane, who has raised little and drawn minimal outside support. Prediction markets on Kalshi and Polymarket both price Gottheimer's chances at about 95 percent.

No public general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on fundamentals: incumbency, the money gap, and a national environment that has favored Democrats this cycle. Those factors point to a comfortable, though not risk-free, Democratic margin. The seat is rated Safe Democratic, with uncertainty somewhat elevated because direct polling evidence is absent.
